'''Korlen Skimmer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] prominent at the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Human, Korlen Skimmer refused to acknowledge his connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], leading him to use his abilities recklessly during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Despite the illegality of [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Skimmer took the scene by storm after winning the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] circa [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Backed by a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] benefactor named [[Calioc/Legends|Calioc]], Skimmer was flooded with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that allowed him to live luxuriously and maintain his [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] with a crew of [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="EV" />

A flamboyant and loud individual, he garnered the attention of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] and the Empire because of his refusal to throw races. Demeaning him a threat, the Hutts began planning his demise, while the Empire hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to detain him, believing that he might be Force-sensitive. Even [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself became curious in Skimmer, decreeing that he and any future successful Human Podracers should be brought before him.<ref name="EV" />

Calioc, fearful to lose on her investment, hired investigators to determine whether the threat to Skimmer's life was serious or hype by competitors. Discovering that a [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] for a powerful Hutt kajidic had hired several racers to ensure Skimmer suffered an accident in his next race, Skimmer and Calioc refused to drop out of the race for pride and greed respectively.<ref name="EV" />
